energy.meaning: Estimated net battery-terminal energy for a common reference BEV.
energy.reference_selection: Stock midsize BEV sedan parameters: 1752 kg, compared with the simulated Lincoln MKZ 2020 at 1696 kg. Fixed 250 W auxiliaries and isothermal operation.
energy.contact_policy: Retain road load and auxiliary energy during contact; exclude impact kinetic work from propulsion and regeneration.
energy.power_limit_policy: Above reference power, hold endpoint motor efficiency and retain full demand. Record extension time, peak power ratio and energy. Require complete motion and contact records.
energy.contact_sensitivity_interpretation: Report sensitivity to positive-only and negative-only impact kinetic-work attribution.
